# Models and schema

## Class and init

```ts
class User extends Model<InferAttributes<User>, InferCreationAttributes<User>> {
  declare id: CreationOptional<number>;
  declare email: string;
  declare active: CreationOptional<boolean>;
}

User.init(
  {
    id: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, primaryKey: true, autoIncrement: true },
    email: { type: DataTypes.STRING, allowNull: false, unique: true },
    active: { type: DataTypes.BOOLEAN, allowNull: false, defaultValue: true },
  },
  { sequelize, tableName: 'llm_users' },
);
```

## define

```ts
const Note = sequelize.define(
  'Note',
  { text: DataTypes.TEXT, meta: DataTypes.JSONB, tags: DataTypes.ARRAY(DataTypes.TEXT) },
  { tableName: 'llm_notes', paranoid: true },
);
```

## Decorators

```ts
@Table({ tableName: 'llm_teams' })
class Team extends Model {
  @PrimaryKey
  @AutoIncrement
  @Column(DataTypes.INTEGER)
  id!: number;

  @AllowNull(false)
  @Column(DataTypes.TEXT)
  name!: string;

  @HasMany(() => Player)
  players?: Player[];
}

@Table({ tableName: 'llm_players' })
class Player extends Model {
  @PrimaryKey
  @AutoIncrement
  @Column(DataTypes.INTEGER)
  id!: number;

  @Column(DataTypes.TEXT)
  nick!: string;

  @ForeignKey(() => Team)
  @Column(DataTypes.INTEGER)
  teamId!: number;
}

sequelize.addModels([Team, Player]);
```

## PostgreSQL column types

```ts
const Line = sequelize.define(
  'Line',
  {
    id: { type: DataTypes.BIGINT, primaryKey: true, identity: 'always' },
    price: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(10, 2), allowNull: false },
    qty: { type: DataTypes.INTEGER, allowNull: false },
    total: { type: DataTypes.DECIMAL(12, 2), generated: { as: literal('"price" * "qty"') } },
    period: DataTypes.INTERVAL,
  },
  { timestamps: false },
);
```

## sync

```ts
const Device = sequelize.define(
  'Device',
  {
    serial: { type: DataTypes.TEXT, unique: { name: 'devices_serial', nullsNotDistinct: true } },
    vendor: DataTypes.TEXT,
    model: DataTypes.TEXT,
  },
  {
    indexes: [
      { fields: ['vendor', 'model'], unique: true, nullsNotDistinct: true },
      { fields: ['model'], where: { vendor: null } },
    ],
  },
);
await sequelize.sync();
```

`sync()` creates missing tables, `{ alter: true }` adjusts columns, `{ force: true }` drops first. Use it for tests and prototypes.

## Migrations with QueryInterface

```ts
export const up = async (queryInterface: QueryInterface): Promise<void> => {
  await queryInterface.createTable('accounts', {
    id: { type: DataTypes.BIGINT, primaryKey: true, autoIncrement: true },
    email: { type: DataTypes.TEXT, allowNull: false, unique: true },
    plan: { type: DataTypes.ENUM('free', 'pro'), allowNull: false, defaultValue: 'free' },
    created_at: { type: DataTypes.DATE, allowNull: false, defaultValue: DataTypes.NOW },
  });
  await queryInterface.createTable('sessions', {
    id: { type: DataTypes.UUID, primaryKey: true },
    account_id: {
      type: DataTypes.BIGINT,
      allowNull: false,
      references: { model: 'accounts', key: 'id', deferrable: Deferrable.INITIALLY_DEFERRED },
      onDelete: 'CASCADE',
    },
  });
  await queryInterface.addIndex('sessions', ['account_id']);
  await queryInterface.addColumn('accounts', 'note', { type: DataTypes.TEXT });
};

export const down = async (queryInterface: QueryInterface): Promise<void> => {
  await queryInterface.dropTable('sessions');
  await queryInterface.dropTable('accounts');
  await queryInterface.dropEnum('enum_accounts_plan');
};
```
